text: {"requester":{"id":"lab-ops-217","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"NiFeCo_OER_thermal_stability_screen_v3","campaign_class":"routine_composition_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate state"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-glass-0412"},"comment":"standard FTO substrate per SOP"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-glass-0412","grid":"8x8"},"comment":"routine init"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":150},"comment":"Co20 Fe30 Ni50 baseline OER catalyst, nominal thickness (nm)"},{"server":"furnace_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":240,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"crystallization step per standard calcination recipe","label":"standard_anneal"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0]},"comment":"register sample point"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2, routine"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":24},"comment":"standard 24 h stability check"},{"server":"ml_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"dataset":"NiFeCo_OER_v3"},"comment":"refit surrogate"}]}
